market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $150 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$104 on May 1 needs +44% to hit $150 (1-min high) by end of June. Even severe Iran-driven price action only produced a brief spike near $110. Base-rate for ~45% move in 60 days is very low absent unprecedented shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black-swan supply shock (war disrupting Strait of Hormuz).
